tasks.description: 1.1 Create `dashboard.model.ts` file in the dashboard directory
1.2 Create `dashboard.view.tsx` file in the dashboard directory
1.3 Create `dashboard.schema.ts` file in the dashboard directory
1.4 Create `dashboard.type.ts` file in the dashboard directory
2.1 Migrate existing validation logic and schemas (e.g., Zod) into `dashboard.schema.ts`
2.2 Define types and interfaces, including View Props and API abstractions, in `dashboard.type.ts`
3.1 Extract all state variables (`useState`, `useReducer`) from the current dashboard page into a `useDashboardModel` hook in `dashboard.model.ts`
3.2 Move data fetching, API calls, and side effects to `useDashboardModel`
3.3 Expose necessary values and action handlers from the hook, ensuring strict typing matching `dashboard.type.ts`
4.1 Migrate all JSX rendering out of `page.tsx` into a stateless `DashboardView` component in `dashboard.view.tsx`
4.2 Update the view component to consume state and dispatch actions purely via its props
5.1 Refactor `page.tsx` to exclusively act as a connector, invoking `useDashboardModel` and passing its return down to `<DashboardView />`
5.2 Validate that the Dashboard functions equivalently to its pre-refactored state with the new MVVM architecture
